resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Prone Horizontal Abduction at 100 Degrees

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Prone Shoulder Flexion with Dumbbell

resolved_via_fuzzy.end_pose_description: Raise the dumbbell forward and upward to shoulder height, leading with your thumb pointing up. Pause at the top while maintaining control, then lower back to the starting position.

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Quadruped Shoulder Stability Rotations

resolved_via_fuzzy.end_pose_description: Reach your right arm across your body and rotate your torso to the left, threading your arm under your body. Return to center and alternate sides.

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart - Overhead

resolved_via_fuzzy.end_pose_description: Slowly pull the band down and back behind your head, stretching across your chest and shoulders. Return to the starting position with controlled movement.

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Resisted Shoulder Abduction

resolved_via_fuzzy.end_pose_description: Lift both arms out to the sides to shoulder height, keeping elbows slightly bent and maintaining tension on the band. The band should resist the lifting motion throughout.

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Scapular Squeezes with Band

resolved_via_fuzzy.end_pose_description: Squeeze your shoulder blades together and pull the band toward your chest, keeping elbows at shoulder height. Hold briefly, then slowly return to the starting position.

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Seated Rows with Resistance Band

resolved_via_fuzzy.end_pose_description: Pull the band handles toward your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Keep your elbows close to your body and return slowly to the starting position.

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Seated Torso Rotation with Arm Swing
resolved_via_fuzzy.start_pose_description: Sit upright in a chair with feet flat on the floor and arms crossed gently over your chest. Keep your hips and lower body still throughout the movement.
resolved_via_fuzzy.end_pose_description: Gently rotate your torso to one side, allowing your arms to swing naturally with the rotation. Return to center and repeat on the opposite side in a slow, controlled manner.

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Shoulder Flexion Mobility - Standing

resolved_via_fuzzy.end_pose_description: Slowly raise both arms overhead in a smooth, controlled motion to ear level or higher as tolerated. Lower arms back down with control and repeat in a rhythmic manner.

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Shoulder Rolls and Stretches

resolved_via_fuzzy.end_pose_description: Slowly roll your shoulders backward in a circular motion, then reverse and roll forward. Gently bring each arm across your chest to stretch the back of the shoulder.

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Shoulder Shrugs with Dumbbells

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Standing Band Pull-Aparts

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Supine Shoulder Flexion Holds

resolved_via_fuzzy.end_pose_description: Maintain the arm position while keeping your shoulder blade stable and packed. Hold this position while ensuring your lower back stays neutral against the floor.

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Supine Shoulder Flexion Slides

resolved_via_fuzzy.end_pose_description: Slowly slide your arm overhead along the surface, raising your shoulder into flexion as far as comfortable. Return to the starting position and repeat.

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Wall Slides with Dumbbell

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Thumb Opposition Exercise

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Standing Marching with Head Turns

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Reverse Wrist Curls with Light Weight

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Thumb Opposition Stretch

resolved_via_fuzzy.name: Wrist Radial Deviation Strengthening
